articles.title: Why this investment bank expects little demand for tokenized stocks despite SEC’s new trading rules
articles.snippet: TD Cowen expects limited demand for tokenized stocks despite new SEC rules opening a path for trading outside traditional markets.

articles.title: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent champions dollar dominance across global markets and stablecoins
articles.snippet: Bessent pushed back against a bearish assessment of the U.S. economy highlighting strong growth, foreign demand for American assets and continued dollar dominance.

articles.title: ECB deploys Pontes platform to settle wholesale tokenized assets in central-bank money
articles.snippet: The EU central bank's new wholesale platform connects DLT market infrastructure to its payment rails, separate from the retail digital euro pilot planned for 2027.

articles.title: Bitcoin hits $85,000 as short squeeze forces out $648 million of bearish bets
articles.snippet: Open interest climbed 7.59% to $156 billion even as positions were closed out, a sign traders are chasing the move rather than stepping back.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin hits $87,000, while traders pile into leveraged bets
articles.snippet: Crypto majors climbed alongside equity futures on Monday, with Monero's XMR up 13%, as Brent fell for a fourth straight session and traders positioned for Trump-Xi summit later this week.
